fusions.name: Shallows Upthrust
fusions.desc: A horn thrust that deals 28 water damage, ignores resistances, and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shaken-Off Spray
fusions.desc: Shakes the water off your hide in a spray 3 tiles ahead of you, dealing 3 water damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each [Soaked] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Placid as Pondwater
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Rolls Right Off
fusions.desc: Each condition laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it. Your armour rises by 5%.
